highlights.brief: 临床试验评估EEG神经反馈BCI用于儿童青少年认知康复，标志非侵入式BCI进展。

items.title_zh: 使用脑机接口神经反馈进行认知康复
items.title_en: Cognitive Rehabilitation Using Neurofeedback With Brain-computer Interface
bullets_zh: ClinicalTrials.gov研究NCT07828496评估基于EEG的神经反馈BCI用于认知康复。
该试验面向儿童和青少年，测试认知结果及损伤相关EEG标志物。
发布于2026-09-18；作为非侵入式临床BCI证据而非植入研究具有相关性。
bullets_en: ClinicalTrials.gov study NCT07828496 evaluates EEG-based neurofeedback BCI for cognitive rehabilitation.
It targets children and adolescents, testing cognitive outcomes and EEG markers of impairment.
Published 2026-09-18; relevant as non-invasive clinical BCI evidence rather than implant work.
items.brief: 临床试验评估EEG神经反馈BCI用于儿童青少年认知康复，标志非侵入式BCI进展。
items.brief_en: Clinical trial of EEG neurofeedback BCI for cognitive rehab in children/adolescents, marking non-invasive BCI progress.
